Elaine called Budget's after-hours service to report that her house was 80 degrees despite having an HSS warranty. The agent documented her request and informed her that the team would follow up after 8 AM, and Elaine said she would call back then as well. The agent also noted that Elaine and Charles are both over 60 years old for the team's reference.

She emphasized the urgency due to having an epileptic child and requested prompt service. The agent documented all details, confirmed contact information and service address, and escalated the issue for priority follow-up since it was after-hours.

The user, Christopher Bogle, called about an urgent cooling issue in his house and requested immediate service. The agent acknowledged the urgency, documented the request, and escalated it for follow-up on the next business day since it was after hours. The call ended with no further requests from the user.

The user, Bryant Opela, called to request air conditioner repair service for the outside unit at his home in O'Fallon, Missouri. He specified that it is not an emergency and requested a regular service appointment for Monday, July 27th, anytime. The agent confirmed the details and informed Bryant that the team will follow up the next business day to confirm availability.

The user called to inquire if Budget was open today and was informed that it is closed on Sundays. The user decided not to leave any details and chose to call back the next business day. The call ended politely with no further action taken.

The user requested the plumbing inspection report for an assessment at 9205 Roger Lee Lane and asked for it to be emailed to two specified addresses. The agent informed the user that it was outside business hours and that the request would be forwarded to the team for follow-up on the next business day.
